title: Build Grave Accord with 60 bosses, fixed threat grades and seven survivor motion sets
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
The game now supports a complete local run through sixty distinct boss identities, seven classes, 378 skills, 28 weapons, six arena layouts and five modes. Bosses keep fixed level/subtier classifications instead of inheriting an encounter number or hidden card-position risk. Hollow Constable is 1+, Bell Triplets are 3--, Brutal uses B and secrets display >10.

Campaign offers select suitable fixed grades while retaining regular/finale roles. Endless keeps seeded bags, exclusive slots and repeat protection; a mature age slot prevents classification preference starving old identities. Grade drives health, projectile pressure and bounty. Normalized base income remains separate from earned premiums, and protocol-13 local Practice saves migrate to protocol 14 while preserving progress and run identity.

The source includes seven complete basic survivor motion sets, dedicated opening-boss defeats and Courier reactions. Drawing continuity fixes run/idle flashing between movement updates and stabilizes facing. Exact cropped identities and bounded current-boss loading reduce texture cost. Five revised secondary maps use different cover topologies and starting axes with no bed props; Soldier/Medic selection art now matches the roster's three-quarter pose and body scale.

Profile, controls, fifteen-locale UI coverage, individual boss music, a dated in-game changelog and twenty-four Wiki illustrations are included. The previously issued Windows/LAN development archive retains its older source/protocol; current source updates do not replace it or redeploy the older public Site/backend.

Validation: all 356 automated tests, authored-content/localization validation, TypeScript and production build pass locally. Real two-client checks cover fixed-grade concealed contracts; 1,800 opening fixtures cover classification consistency across modes/difficulties. Independent art/reference reconstruction and scoped endurance/recovery evidence are preserved. The current analytical model has 14,070 feasible offensive-budget rows under explicit assumptions; this is separate from human balance or device performance.

This remains a draft. Stronger distinct phase changes and movement, ability-changing talents, an optional branching skill-tree view, final hosted/recovery/capacity/device acceptance and coordinated release remain unfinished. Three ordinary bosses in all fifty subtiers requires 150 ordinary identities; current coverage is 59 ordinary plus one secret, with 91 additional ordinary identities still needed. Protected main remains unchanged.
